name: LoRA Image Curator v0.28.4 source/provider SBOM

creationInfo.comment: Source/provider scope. The future portable build augments this inventory from its exact private runtime and locked wheels.

packages.name: florence-community/Florence-2-large-ft
packages.supplier: Organization: Florence-2 Community; model developed by Microsoft
packages.comment: Function: Image captioning, object detection, and OCR triage. Restriction: No additional model-specific use restriction identified; the MIT terms still apply. Integrity: Pinned repository revision plus safetensors-only native loading. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: transformers
packages.comment: Function: Native Florence-2 execution. Restriction: None identified beyond the license terms. Integrity: Exact package version; portable wheel hashes are generated during the locked Windows build. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: torch / torchvision CUDA 13.0
packages.comment: Function: GPU tensor runtime for Florence and compatible providers. Restriction: Requires a compatible NVIDIA GPU and Windows driver 580.88 or newer. Integrity: Exact package pair and official wheel index; wheel hash depends on Python/Windows tag. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: torch / torchvision CPU
packages.versionInfo: selected from the official stable CPU index
packages.comment: Function: CPU tensor runtime for Florence and compatible providers. Restriction: CPU inference is supported but substantially slower than a compatible GPU. Integrity: Official wheel index; exact portable CPU pack remains a future locked Windows-build decision. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: mediapipe
packages.comment: Function: Optional local body and pose analysis. Restriction: None identified beyond the license terms. Integrity: Portable wheel version and hash are locked during the future Windows runtime build. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Full float16
packages.comment: Function: Optional local 33-landmark body and pose analysis. Restriction: MediaPipe Solutions Preview model; automated results are review evidence, not a guarantee. Integrity: Exact publisher-hosted model bytes. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: insightface
packages.comment: Function: Optional face detection and embedding runtime. Restriction: Code license does not grant rights to separately distributed pretrained weights. Integrity: Exact package version; portable wheel/source hashes remain a later build decision. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: buffalo_l
packages.comment: Function: Optional face detection and embedding model pack. Restriction: Non-commercial research use only unless separately licensed. Integrity: Not mirrored or bundled; user installs from the publisher or supplies a licensed compatible pack. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: onnxruntime / onnxruntime-gpu
packages.comment: Function: Optional InsightFace inference runtime. Restriction: The GPU package line must match the CUDA generation used by the local runtime. Integrity: Installer selects a documented CUDA-compatible package line. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: ffmpeg executable
packages.supplier: Organization: FFmpeg project or selected third-party Windows builder
packages.licenseConcluded: LGPL-2.1-or-later by default; some builds are GPL-2.0-or-later
packages.licenseDeclared: LGPL-2.1-or-later by default; some builds are GPL-2.0-or-later
packages.comment: Function: Optional local video-frame extraction. Restriction: The exact external build controls its license and corresponding-source obligations. Integrity: User-selected executable is validated at use time; no build is distributed by this release. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: Send2Trash
packages.comment: Function: Native operating-system Trash / Recycle Bin requests. Restriction: No permanent-delete fallback is provided when the native trash request fails. Integrity: Portable wheel version and hash are locked during the future Windows runtime build. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: numpy
packages.comment: Function: Array and numeric operations. Restriction: None identified beyond the license terms. Integrity: Portable wheel version and hash are locked during the future Windows runtime build. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: Pillow
packages.comment: Function: Local image decoding and manipulation. Restriction: None identified beyond the license terms. Integrity: Portable wheel version and hash are locked during the future Windows runtime build. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: einops
packages.comment: Function: Tensor-shape operations required by Florence. Restriction: None identified beyond the license terms. Integrity: Portable wheel version and hash are locked during the future Windows runtime build. Bundled in source release: False.

packages.name: timm
packages.comment: Function: Vision model utilities required by Florence. Restriction: None identified beyond the license terms. Integrity: Portable wheel version and hash are locked during the future Windows runtime build. Bundled in source release: False.
